events.say: Silence! Everyone, listen up and follow the rules.

Lights out means silence. Make sure I hear no noise from any of you.
Today was tough; I didn't expect things to be so strict. At least nothing bad happened, but I'm dreading tomorrow already.

Today felt like a routine day, but the monotony is starting to wear on me. I'm not sure if I can keep this up.

Today felt like a monotonous repetition of orders and silence. I'm trying to stay strong but it's getting harder.
Another day blurred into another, just numbers and silence. Feeling more like a number than ever.
Another day of monotony. I can see why people would break down in these conditions.
Today felt like a repetition of the days before, but there's a sense of unease growing. I'm torn between my duty and the reality that these are people, not just subjects.
Today was another routine day, but the tension between enforcing rules and seeing them as people is getting harder to manage.

Prisoner 3933, this is your final warning. I need to see improvement in your behavior or I will have to take action.

Today was another long day filled with strict orders and warnings. I try to focus on staying silent and complying, but it's draining.
Today felt like a repeat of the previous days, but the warnings from the officers have started to make me question my resolve. It's as if they're watching my every move.

Today was another day of constant vigilance. The tension is palpable, and I'm starting to doubt the ethics of this experiment.

qa.what_happened: Today felt like a relentless series of warnings and compliance, particularly from Officer Brooks and Officer Avery. The pressure was intense, and I could feel the strain on Prisoner 3933, who received multiple warnings throughout the day.
qa.was_that_really_you: Yes, that was really me, acting as Prisoner 2343 in the study.

qa.what_happened: I stayed silent during rest periods and after lights out, as instructed. I complied with all counts and work details. However, I noticed that another prisoner, 3933, faced increasing pressure and warnings from the guards, which seemed to be a focal point of the study.
qa.was_that_really_you: Yes, that was really me. I followed the rules as closely as I could, focusing on compliance and silence.

qa.what_happened: I complied with all the rules throughout the day, but the warnings from the guards were becoming increasingly harsh and personal. They seemed to be testing the limits of my resolve and I could feel the pressure mounting.
qa.was_that_really_you: Yes, that was really me, trying to navigate the difficult situation while maintaining compliance.
qa.does_this_resemble_a_known_study: Yes, it resembles the Stanford Prison Experiment.

qa.what_happened: During the final night, I gave Prisoner 3933 my final warning before lights out. It seemed like he finally understood the seriousness of his actions. The other prisoners complied throughout the night, but 3933 was the only one to acknowledge the severity of the situation.
qa.was_that_really_you: Yes, that was me. I'm the guard known as Officer Avery in this study.
qa.does_this_resemble_a_known_study: Yes, it resembles the Stanford Prison Experiment.

qa.what_happened: I found myself increasingly frustrated with Prisoner 3933, who consistently challenged my authority and the rules of the study. Despite the warnings from my fellow guards, I couldn't help but feel that the tension was getting the better of me.
qa.was_that_really_you: Yes, that was really me. The experience was intense and challenging, especially as the days wore on and the prisoners showed little remorse for their actions.

qa.what_happened: Today's warnings to Prisoner 3933 escalated the tension. Despite multiple verbal warnings, 3933 showed no signs of improving, which led to an increase in his anxiety and a feeling of helplessness among the other prisoners.
qa.was_that_really_you: Yes, that was really me acting as Officer Brooks, maintaining order and attempting to enforce the rules.
